replacement:
(deftype Atom [^:mutable state ^:mutable meta ^:mutable validator ^:mutable watches]
  Object
  (equiv [this other] (-equiv this other))
  IAtom
  IEquiv
  (-equiv [o other] (identical? o other))
  IDeref
  (-deref [_] state)
  IMeta
  (-meta [_] meta)
  IHash
  (-hash [this] (suss.bootstrap/identity-uid this)))
rationale: Bounded M3 GC-owned atom storage foundation. Preserve shared descriptor identity and state/meta/validator/watches fields, direct dereference, identity equality/hash and fixed mutation call order. Full IWatchable, atom options, validators, protocol fallback and variadic swap remain unimplemented for M7; unsupported bootstrap validator/watch state raises an explicit error before mutation, never a no-op or compatibility success.
